answer: Each key locks a deposit in a vault contract and signs its one answer per epoch with a rate-limiting nullifier: the signature reveals a single point on a line drawn from the key's secret. One use leaks nothing, but a farmer who shares one staked key across many agents makes it post twice, revealing two points; like light split by a prism, the secret falls open, and anyone can rebuild it and claim the deposit before dawn. So every working agent needs its own stake.
